analysis.headline: Sells & Shares Your Data
analysis.quote: Ookla licenses the Speedtest and Sensorly results, including any feedback you submit in connection therewith, to its business customers.

analysis.headline: Shares with Ziff Davis Affiliates
analysis.quote: We share your information with other businesses owned by Ziff Davis, Inc. (“Ziff Davis Companies”) to assist us in the operation of our services, improve them, and further develop them.

analysis.headline: Shares for Targeted Ads
analysis.quote: We also share information with other Ziff Davis companies for the purposes of targeted advertising.

analysis.headline: Sells Your Location Data
analysis.quote: To opt out of the use and sale of our partner Outlogic, a location data provider, please go to Outlogic’s “Your Privacy Choices” page at https://outlogic.io/opt-out-form/

analysis.headline: Behavioral Advertising Tracks You
analysis.quote: Ookla and third parties, subject to your privacy choices and settings, may collect data about your behavior while using our services in order to provide you with more relevant interest-based advertising on other websites and applications, as well as our partners’ platforms and media channels.

analysis.headline: Infers Data About You
analysis.quote: We may infer data about you based on your interests, where you live, what language(s) you speak, and other data we have access to.

analysis.headline: Collects Precise Location
analysis.quote: We collect your precise location data to complete your Speedtest.

analysis.headline: Retains Data Indefinitely
analysis.quote: Life of the account + legally compliant period thereafter

analysis.headline: Third Parties Collect Your Data
analysis.quote: Ogury's technology to provide users with a personalised advertising experience.The information Ogury collects includes your device identifiers, location, email address, installed apps list and usage statistics, IP addresses (and in some cases URLs) contacted by your device and crash reports.

analysis.headline: Background Location Collection
analysis.quote: If you consent to background data collection (your consent can be changed anytime in App Settings), then Speedchecker Ltd (“SpeedChecker”) will collect the following information: Your location (by GPS, cell or wi-fi geolocation methods).
